title: Chapter 257 The Immortal Emperor Ranking Opens
content:
Chapter 257 The Immortal Emperor Ranking Opens

Looking back at the hazy world behind me.

There is the fairy world.

Now, this fairy world has been targeted, and it won’t take long to attack the fairy world by enemies outside the domain.

With the current strength of the fairy world, it is basically impossible to block this powerful enemy outside the domain.

At least not now.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng suddenly had a divine light in his eyes.

His penetrating eyes immediately glanced at the entire fairy world.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng suddenly sneered.

"Haha, hehe, a good means, really a good means."

"I actually thought of using this method to protect myself."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng had seen through everything.

His daughter has become a destined person in the entire fairy world. She has supreme luck, but she also has the important task of saving the entire fairy world.

This is a kind of self-salvation in the fairy world.

But Lu Daosheng obviously did not agree so much.

If the enemy outside the domain really wants to put the entire immortal world in danger, then it is not impossible for him to take action in the deserted city.

Maybe you can also take action yourself to directly relieve the danger.

But now, this responsibility is imposed on his daughter, which makes Lu Daosheng extremely unhappy.

After looking at the depths of the galaxy again, Lu Daosheng turned around and left.

......

"Is this outside the fairy world?"

“I felt the guidance of strength.”

A middle-aged man in a yellow robe walked in the starry sky with free and easy steps.

It is the Yuan Emperor who has just broken through the tribulation.

And at this moment, Emperor Yuan suddenly stopped.

"It's you?!"

A hint of astonishment suddenly appeared on Emperor Yuan's face.

I saw a man suddenly appeared not far away in front of Emperor Yuan at some point.

Lu Daosheng!

When Lu Daosheng saw Emperor Yuan, he was also a little surprised.

"You haven't seen each other for many years, and your strength has improved a lot."

Lu Daosheng smiled and seemed to have seen an old friend who had not seen him for many years, and he didn't care about the matter of the Instant Novel Emperor back then.

Looking at Lu Daosheng who had not changed at all in front of him, Emperor Yuan also grinned.

"This is still a blessing for you."

"If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have made a breakthrough so quickly."

Emperor Yuan was naturally grateful to Lu Daosheng. He was so arrogant back then that he had no setbacks along the way, so he was stuck at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm and could not make any breakthroughs.

Until Lu Daosheng's arrival, he punched open the door in his heart.

Break all his pride.

Since then, his mind and nature have completely transformed.

He is still him, but he is not the same as he used to be.

It is precisely because of this that he was able to make a breakthrough.

Hearing Emperor Yuan say this, Lu Daosheng suddenly laughed and said, "Then how do you plan to repay me?"

As soon as these words were spoken, the smile on Emperor Yuan's face suddenly froze.

You beat me up, do you want me to repay you?

I'm just being polite.

Emperor Yuan was speechless and for a moment, he didn't know what to say.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"I won't joke with you anymore, I'll tell you something serious."

Upon hearing this, Emperor Yuan suddenly looked solemn.

"What's the matter?"

"You can't leave this world yet."

"Why?"

Emperor Yuan looked puzzled. He had already faintly exceeded the limit of this world and could already walk out of this world.

But now, you don't let me go.

Faced with Emperor Yuan’s doubts, Lu Daosheng slowly turned around and waved his sleeves.

Buzz —

The space in front of me suddenly rippled.

A picture was presented to Emperor Yuan.

I saw thousands of strange people standing there in a quiet starry sky, with evil spirits all over my body, and I knew it was definitely not a good person at first glance.

The person in charge was even more evil. Even if it was just a video, the aura still made Emperor Yuan tremble all over.

So strong.

Emperor Yuan held his eyes tightly, his face a little solemn.

There are indeed countless more powerful existences in this world.

The next moment, the scene suddenly changed, and a figure suddenly appeared in the starry sky, and a terrifying murderous intent instantly dyed the entire starry sky blood-red.

Next, there is a massacre on one hand.

None of the thousands of strange people escaped and all died in the starry sky.

And that figure was Lu Daosheng in front of Emperor Yuan.

The picture dissipated, and Emperor Yuan remained silent for a long time.

With his eyesight, he naturally saw that this was true, and it happened not long ago.

"Is there any danger in the fairy world?"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

Seeing this, Emperor Yuan looked solemn, "When I break through, God will destroy me."

The last heavenly tribulation almost wanted to make him die.

And now, he survived and wanted him to protect the fairy world in turn?

For a moment, Emperor Yuan felt a little complicated.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, "This spirit in the fairy world is indeed very good at doing things, but that heavenly tribulation has tempered you better, right?"

Feeling the surging power in his body, Emperor Yuan was silent.

Seeing Emperor Yuan hesitating, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, "It's up to you to decide whether to stay or not."

After saying this, Lu Daosheng continued to move forward.

Left Emperor Yuan alone, standing in the starry sky.

Lu Daosheng is still optimistic about Emperor Yuan.

A very talented and responsible person.

Strength is also an indispensable powerful combat power for the current fairy world.

But none of these matters.

The most important thing about whether this fairy world can survive this disaster is what your daughter thinks.

As long as Lu Xue nods, there will be nothing wrong in the fairy world.

.........

On the other side, the center of the fairyland.

Xiao Yin, who was standing in front of the list of Immortal Emperors, suddenly discovered that the Yuan Emperor, who was originally ranked first, suddenly disappeared.

"Emperor Yuan?"

Xiao Yin naturally heard of Emperor Yuan. He once made a great reputation in the Immortal Realm, and then returned to the Golden Immortal Realm to attain enlightenment and become emperor.

In the end, he reached the top of the list of Immortal Emperors and became famous in the entire fairy world.

But now, such a person has disappeared from the Immortal Emperor List.

Then there are only two possibilities, either Emperor Yuan is dead.

Or,

Xiao Yin's expression was slightly solemn.

Thinking of the slight fluctuations that had just come from the Golden Immortal Realm, Xiao Yin suddenly smiled.

"I originally wanted to challenge the first place in the Immortal Emperor List. If that's the case, I will take the position of the No. 1 in the Immortal Emperor List."

There are cultural lists, martial lists, monster lists, and immortal emperor lists.

But the first three lists were created by man.

Even the list of extremely valuable monsters, such as the Monster List, was created by the joint efforts of several super forces in the Immortal Realm.

But the list of Immortal Emperors is different.

The Immortal Emperor List is created by heaven and earth, and has the supreme Tao.

There are only ten places on the list, and every powerful Immortal Emperor Realm on the list is a peak existence.

Similarly, there will still be rich rewards on the list, otherwise any immortal emperor will be able to make the list after he has nothing to do.

At this moment, Xiao Yin no longer hesitated and directly pressed his hand on the list of Immortal Emperors.

For a moment, the great way roared and the laws trembled.

"The Immortal Emperor List is on."

"The one who opens, Xiao Yin."

"The realm is the peak of the Immortal Emperor realm."
